scope: Research catalogue for Suomisaundi music, community, history, people, organizations, works and provenance.

milestones.summary: Ruskababa introduced Goa trance through Finnish underground summertime parties.
Early Tim Thick recordings circulated in Goa and contributed to the emerging Suomisaundi sound.
Flippin Bixies was self-published and is described by historical sources as genre-defining.
Exogenic Records began focusing on Suomisaundi; Midiliitto formed around the same period.

sources.name: Suomisaundi.fi
sources.scope: artists, labels, discographies and genre catalogue

provenance.policy: Every promoted catalogue fact must retain attributable source evidence. Conflicts and uncertain claims remain explicitly qualified.
